# Tour 27 Destination Intelligence — providers

| Provider | Truth class | Capability | Coverage | Required secret | Access / licence | Implementation | Freshness semantics |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| USGS | OBSERVATION | earthquakes | global | - | OPEN (attribution per USGS terms) | implemented | fresh 5 min; on upstream failure a copy up to 30 min old is served flagged `stale: true` |
| NASA_FIRMS | OBSERVATION | thermal-detections | global | `NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY` | OPEN (NASA data policy; MAP_KEY registration) | implemented | fresh 10 min; stale copy up to 1 h flagged `stale: true`; degraded answers cached 1 min and never reused as stale |
| NASA_EONET | ENVIRONMENTAL_CONTEXT | environmental-events | global | - | OPEN (attribution) | implemented | fresh 15 min; stale copy up to 2 h flagged `stale: true`; degraded (one box failed) cached 1 min |
| MET_NORWAY | FORECAST | forecast | global | - | OPEN (attribution "Data from MET Norway"; honest User-Agent required) | implemented | fresh until the provider's exact `Expires` (fallback 10 min); stale window 6 h from expiry; conditional `If-Modified-Since` refresh |
| NWS | OFFICIAL_WARNING | official-warnings-us | United States | - | OPEN (US Government; honest User-Agent required) | implemented | fresh from `max-age` clamped 5-60 s (default 30 s); outside-coverage cached 1 h; official warnings are never served stale |
| ECCC | OFFICIAL_WARNING | official-warnings-ca | Canada (public + marine forecast zones) | - | OPEN (Open Government Licence - Canada; attribution) | implemented | alerts fresh 1 min (never stale); zone geography 24 h (empty 1 h); fail-closed budget 40 req/min |
| BOM | OFFICIAL_WARNING | official-warnings-au | Australia | - | LICENCE_PENDING (commercial licence not yet obtained) | LICENCE_PENDING | not implemented (licence pending) |
| METEOALARM | OFFICIAL_WARNING | official-warnings-eu | Europe (38 NMHS) | `METEOALARM_API_TOKEN` | TOKEN_PENDING (API token not yet issued; applicability unproven) | TOKEN_PENDING | not implemented (token pending) |

`LICENCE_PENDING` (BOM) and `TOKEN_PENDING` (MeteoAlarm) are expected states, not failures. Absence of an alert is never evidence of safety.

## Configuration (names only, never values)

- `OSIRIS_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=tour27-gateway` — deny everything except the allow-listed Tour 27 routes.
- `OSIRIS_SERVICE_TOKEN` — bearer token the Tour 27 backend presents; `OSIRIS_SERVICE_TOKEN_NEXT` — second accepted token for rotation.
- `NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY` — NASA_FIRMS.
- `METEOALARM_API_TOKEN` — METEOALARM.

## Deployment assumption: cache, budgets and scale-out

Supported deployment: a SINGLE OSIRIS gateway instance with an in-memory cache. Do not run multiple replicas until a shared cache / request budget exists (see the per-provider scale-out column).

| Provider | Correctness consequence | Provider-load consequence | Restart consequence | Scale-out consequence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USGS | None: stateless per query. | One upstream call per distinct query per fresh window per instance. | Cold cache; stale fallback lost until the next success. | Load multiplies by instance count; no correctness impact. |
| NASA_FIRMS | None; degraded answers are never reused as stale. | Counts against the MAP_KEY transaction allowance per instance. | Cold cache; stale fallback lost. | MAP_KEY allowance is consumed by ALL instances but not coordinated: multiply load by N before scaling. |
| NASA_EONET | None. | One or two calls per query per fresh window per instance. | Cold cache; stale fallback lost. | Load multiplies; no correctness impact. |
| MET_NORWAY | None; exact Expires respected per instance. | MET Norway terms require respecting Expires and conditional requests; each instance does so independently. | Loses Last-Modified/Expires state, so the first request per location is unconditional. | N instances = N independent conditional-request streams; keep well inside MET Norway load guidance or use a shared cache first. |
| NWS | None: alerts are never served stale and per-point cache is short. | One call per point per fresh window per instance (max-age respected). | Cold cache; nothing safety-relevant is lost. | Load multiplies; no correctness impact. |
| ECCC | None: current alerts are always read BEFORE cached geography. | The 40 req/min budget is PER INSTANCE and fail-closed; with N instances the effective ceiling is N x 40. | Budget window and zone cache reset, so a restart burst is possible; single-flight limits it. | The budget is not globally shared; do not scale beyond one instance without a shared budget/cache (Redis) or a lowered per-instance limit. |
| BOM | n/a (not implemented) | n/a | n/a | n/a |
| METEOALARM | n/a (not implemented) | n/a | n/a | n/a |
